_arch_note: LUT ABLATION, SELECTIVITY-MATCHED DISCONTINUOUS CONTROL FOR exp_g_0243 (min_margin): sharp_margin gamma=1.75, gain=3.9. On exp_g_0193's trained margins gamma=1.75 reproduces min_margin's ENTIRE selectivity profile (within-token CV 1.90 vs 1.97, p75/p25 11.3 vs 12.2, frac<1e-3 0.6% vs 1.0%), so the pair 0245 / 0243 differs in essentially nothing but continuity -- the primary, cleanest matched comparison. Against tanh_margin it matches CV only (p75/p25 11.3 vs 60, frac 0.6% vs 10.6%). Gain 3.9 = margin:form mean-score ratio on exp_g_0193's trained margins (6.6 at init, 3.3 after 4K steps); a boundary crossing keeps ~47% of the score; 0.5^(8*1.75) = 6.1e-5. Forked VERBATIM from exp_g_0193_B16k_light_margin_tph128_noznorm_seed1 (LightMHL n=1, margin, no z_norm, H4 tph128 nap8 d_in=d_out=48, 6L d384 6 heads seq512, device_batch 12 x grad_accum 4 = 24,576 tokens, lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, warmup 0.1, seed 1, lut_base_seed 1000, tables_no_decay, untied, corrected eval bs48x100 skip-12, final 1.172852). CHANGES, exactly three: lut_confidence_form margin -> sharp_margin, i.e. score = gain * (sum_j |d_j|) * (prod_j sigmoid(2|d_j|))^gamma -- DISCONTINUOUS at every cell boundary like margin (sigmoid(0)=0.5, never 0) but far more selective across tables; lut_sharp_margin_gamma (the gamma this run uses, read from THIS config by model_build and printed per layer to train.log); lut_confidence_gain (scale-matched to margin's mean score 0.547 on exp_g_0193's trained margins). sharp_margin is not in the native scored-eval kernel: no-grad eval uses the torch path. BOTH ARMS ARE RUN because neither gamma matches tanh_margin on ALL selectivity axes at once (gamma~1.75 matches within-token CV, gamma~3 matches p75/p25 and the near-zero fraction); with a single arm, whichever statistic went unmatched would remain an escape hatch for interpreting the result. Calibration and the preregistered reading: doc/research/lut_ablation/notes_sharp_margin.md, sharp_margin_calibration.py. References (corrected protocol): exp_g_0193 1.172852 (margin), exp_g_0243 1.197236 (min_margin), exp_g_0244 1.186730 (tanh_margin), exp_g_0195 1.160637 (n=2 learnable tau).
